mathematical_sources.note: Background for the finite occupation-space and operator method. The SRHT bounds are proved in this development; they are not hypotheses imported from a SparseStack theorem. Reused Lean infrastructure is separately recorded under related_formalizations.

related_formalizations.note: The vendored SparseFockFormal library originated in this project, including finite probability, finite L2 spaces, matrix tails, and the limited-independence extension. Original namespaces and MIT attribution are retained. The present repository includes the consumed sources and any SRHT-specific adaptations, so it is a substantive development rather than a thin external Comparator wrapper.
